item.text:
It provides basic order calculations: totals, code-based discounts, an “average” price, and formatted receipts.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; the final access is `undefined`, causing a `TypeError`. Use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides a quantity-weighted order total by the number of distinct line items, so it is not an average item price when `qty > 1`. It should divide by total quantity (or sum `price` values, depending on intended definition).
- Empty `items` cannot be handled because of the first bug; after fixing it, `averageItemPrice([])` returns `NaN` and needs a defined empty-case behavior.
